# Attribution Notice: @homebridge/hap-nodejs (Secure Video Fork)

This package is a compiled vendoring of the `secure-video` branch from the HAP-NodeJS fork maintained by seydx and the Homebridge team.

- Source Repository: https://github.com/seydx/HAP-NodeJS
- Branch: `secure-video`
- Commit: `d81fba565ee26e82170d5f4f8cd358c2fd773f6c`
- Upstream: https://github.com/homebridge/HAP-NodeJS
- Original Author: Khaos Tian <khaos.tian@gmail.com>
- Contributors: Andreas Bauer <mail@anderl-bauer.de>, Seyed Ghasem Emami (seydx), and HAP-NodeJS contributors.
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE)

This vendored build contains the compiled `dist/` artifacts required for Apple HomeKit Secure Video 3 (HKSV3) and HEVC multi-tier RTP and WebRTC streaming controllers (`SecureVideoController`).
